text_block_list.text:
Pi-chaaan, where aaare youuu? 
Pi-chaaaaaaaan!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
On my way home one night. Turning toward 
the sound of voices, I caught sight of an 
unusual trio.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Just as I thought a familiar gentle breeze 
had blown in... it turns out to be you, 
Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: She means Hiyo-san.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
There was a brown-eared bulbul that 
Tannhauser-san kept seeing around the 
academy these past few days, but it looks 
like it hasn't been around since this 
morning.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Ugh, and here I thought today would be the 
day we'd become friends and you'd perch on 
my shoulder~!

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
The wind that blows for Pi-chan-san is 
different from ours. It is delicate, and 
once it mingles with a different world, it 
changes form and can never return to how 
it was—

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
"A wind that has been transformed will 
find it difficult to return to how it once 
was."
choice_data_list:
Does taking it in mean it won't be able to 
return to the wild?

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Yes.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
I-I see... But are they gonna be okay? 
What if they got hurt, or caught up in 
something terrible?

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Even if we can't be together... at least I 
want to see you doing well.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
...Indeed. If it's only to confirm whether 
she has suffered from blatant 
ostracization or not.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
From the red...? Ah, Zephyr-chan, wait 
up~!

text_block_list.name: Mysterious Cry
text_block_list.text: G-Gyogyogyogyo! GYOOOOEEEE--!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Gyah!? What is this voice... !?

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
C-Could it be a ghost or something?? I 
heard a weird noise over there just now...

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: I-It can't be...!

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Even if it is a ghost... there is no need 
to be afraid.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
The sun wind is wind, and the shadow wind 
is also wind. All are life cradled in the 
arms of the earth.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
"To nature, both they and we are equal, 
simply parts of the same existence... Any 
differences between us are trivial."

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
"If you face reality without averting your 
eyes, the gentle breeze will surely carry 
your fears away."

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
I see... Coming from a nature-lover like 
Zephyr-san, that certainly is convincing.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Mun-mun! Thanks to you, it's not feeling 
as scary anymore!

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Is that so? If I was able to relieve 
everyone's anxiety, that is a blessing.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: "Ah, Tannhauser-san. Over there is—"

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: It's Pi-chan! ...Wait.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Looks like she's hanging out with a flock 
of birds.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
P-chan... I just wanted to see all my 
friends...

text_block_list.name: P-chan
text_block_list.text: Hiyo-hiyo!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After circling around as if to say 
goodbye, Pi-chan flew off toward the 
mountains with the rest of the flock.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Pi-chan-san has likely returned to where 
they belong, haven't they?

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Ugh, P-chaaan...

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
You're right... We are all connected 
within the same wind.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
If you wander through nature and keep 
walking, I'm sure you'll meet again.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
That's right. If you're mountain climbing 
with Zephyr-san, it might just pop its 
head out unexpectedly.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Yeah, that's true... Thank you, everyone!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
*sniff*... I need to report this to 
Kuu-chan and the others when I get home...

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. Those two were perched together on a 
tree—

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Th-There were others, too...?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I couldn't help but silently agree with 
King Halo's retort.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Yes. For P-chan, being with the flock is 
natural and makes them happy.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
“I see... It's lonely for me being 
separated from my friends too, you know.”

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
I have to send Pi-chan off with a 
smile...!

text_block_list.name: Mysterious Voice
text_block_list.text: Cheer... up...

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Um... Was that just now Zephyr-chan? 
King-chan? Or Zephyr-chan's Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
No. By the way, everyone, do you remember 
what I mentioned earlier?

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
N-Not looking away, and accepting reality 
as it is...?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Wait, there's no way I can do this, 
seriously?!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Taking the bewildered Yamanin Zephyr by 
the hand, everyone hastily made their exit 
from the scene.
